calibration.source: Supplied MegaScenes COLMAP poses and SIMPLE_RADIAL intrinsics, converted to OpenGL camera-to-world transforms.
calibration.seed_policy: Keep sparse points tracked by at least two selected training photos.
calibration.limitation: The upstream MegaScenes camera fit used registered evaluation photos; the evaluated image pixels were not sent into either appearance training run.

hardware.training: Apple M4 integrated GPU for both runs, sequentially
hardware.remote: Thunder L40 restored, verified and deleted. Automatic permission review rejected uploading the photos, pose data, and training script. Neither reconstruction ran on Thunder.

photo_only_result: Minimum alignment gate failed for both photo-only camera solutions. Shared held-out render scores were withheld.

calibrated_team.workflow: Spirula Studio v2026.11.12, 2,000 full-resolution in-the-wild steps, cap 500,000, scene-center none, supplied cameras and seed.

calibrated_astra.workflow: Codex GPT-6.2 Astra independently chose PyTorch 2.15.0 MPS optimization, 60,000 extra image-derived seeds, 2,000 patch draws and 1,834 optimizer updates.

evaluation: Identical supplied held-out cameras, image dimensions and image bytes. Both PLYs rendered by Spirula Studio v2026.11.12 at zero optimization steps. Mean full-image PSNR and SSIM before compression or cleanup.
scope: Compare the observed quality and elapsed training time under supplied calibration. Full-frame steps and patch updates consume different compute. The missing rear-sector condition remains pending.

orbit.observations: The team run retains arch and minaret detail with haze and missing ground. Astra has broad translucent splats and less defined dome and facade. Both show gaps during the orbit.
orbit.scores: Novel orbit views have no reference photos. Only the 21 real held-out cameras contributed to the reported scores.
